title: Time-Series Database Guide
title_es: Guía de Bases de Datos de Series Temporales
description: Runnable TimescaleDB companion: minimal hypertable setup with continuous aggregates and retention, plus the complete 10K-sensor IoT scenario and engine comparison notes (InfluxDB, TimescaleDB, ClickHouse).
